warnings: Six connection details of the steel TRUSS T1, numbered 1-6 by the callout bubbles on S-08 (1 and 2 at the RC column heads on rows A/B, 3 at the steel corridor post on row C, 4 at the bottom chord under the ridge, 5 at the ridge, 6 at a web-to-rafter joint). The bubble number is a view reference, not a member mark, so element_id is null and the number is kept in detail_ref.
Anchor bars: 'เหล็ก ø15มม ทำเกลียวฝังในเสา 0.30ม' — two per bearing as drawn; the count is drawn, not printed.
element_type connection_detail is in the section 0.4 list; components are kept verbatim in components_printed_as (no steel_section object: each detail mixes several sections).
